name: Question 8
problem:
Consider the augmented matrix $M$ given by 

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}-1 & 3 & -5 & 6 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}].
$$

Find the general solution of the linear system represented by the matrix.
worked_solution:
The system corresponding to $M$ is

$$
{\begin{aligned}-x+3y-5z=6 \\ 0x+0y+0z=0 \\ 0x+0y+0z=0.\end{aligned}
$$

Since any numbers $x,y,z$ form a solution of the final two equations $0x+0y+0z=0,$ we can remove these equations from the system. So, our system now consists of just a single equation:

$$
-x+3y-5z=6
$$

The basic variables are the variables whose coefficients are pivots. In this case, the basic variable is $x$, and we have two free variables $y$ and $z.$ That means we need to find $x$ in terms of $y,z.$ Doing this, we get

$$
x=-6+3y-5z.
$$

Therefore, the general solution is

$$
{\begin{aligned}x=-6+3y-5z \\ y=y \\ z=z,\end{aligned}
$$

where $y$, $z$ (free variables) are arbitrary numbers.

In vector form, the solution can be written as

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}-6+3y-5z \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}-6 \\ 0 \\ 0\end{aligned}]+y[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 1 \\ 0\end{aligned}]+z[\begin{aligned}-5 \\ 0 \\ 1\end{aligned}],\,y,z\in (-\infty ,\infty ).\end{aligned}
$$

Question 8
?

Consider the augmented matrix M given by M=[−13−5600000000]. Find the general solution of the linear system represented by the matrix.

a
[−600]+y[−510]+z[301],y,z∈(−∞,∞)
b
[600]+y[−301]+z[510],y,z∈(−∞,∞)
c
[−300]+y[610]+z[−501],y,z∈(−∞,∞)
d
[−600]+y[310]+z[−501],y,z∈(−∞,∞)
e
No solution
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

The system corresponding to M is {−x+3y−5z=60x+0y+0z=00x+0y+0z=0.

Since any numbers x,y,z form a solution of the final two equations 0x+0y+0z=0, we can remove these equations from the system. So, our system now consists of just a single equation:

−x+3y−5z=6

The basic variables are the variables whose coefficients are pivots. In this case, the basic variable is x, and we have two free variables y and z. That means we need to find x in terms of y,z. Doing this, we get

x=−6+3y−5z.

Therefore, the general solution is

{x=−6+3y−5zy=yz=z,

where y, z (free variables) are arbitrary numbers.

In vector form, the solution can be written as [xyz]=[−6+3y−5zyz]=[−600]+y[310]+z[−501],y,z∈(−∞,∞).
